_readme: Per-repo configuration for the shared gate tests installed from commons (@thiengthb/test-*). Keeping it here means the test files stay byte-identical to the registry copies — an exception is data, never an edit to the check. Prefer an inline `rulebook-allow: <rule-id> — <reason>` directive in the code itself; that one sentence satisfies both the generation-time hook and the test. The lists below are for a burn-down at install time, on an app that already has drift.
